title: माग्नेको गीत कवितामा ध्वन्यार्थ
nepali: प्रस्तुत अध्ययन ‘माग्नेको गीत’ कवितामा निहित ध्वन्यार्थको अध्ययनसँग सम्बन्धित रहेको छ । ‘माग्नेको गीत’ कविताको शीर्षक ,पद÷पदावली र प्रकरणमा के कस्तो ध्वन्यार्थ रहेको छ भन्ने जिज्ञासालाई पुस्तकालयीय अध्ययन कार्यको अनुशासनमा बसी सङ्कलन गरिएको सामग्रीलाई गुणात्मक अनुसन्धान ढाँचाको अनुप्रयोग गरी समीक्षण गरिएको छ । निम्न वर्गका अतिशय उत्पीडन अभिव्यञ्जित भएको ‘माग्नेको गीत’ कवितामा मान्छेले मान्छेलाई हेला, घृणा र शोषण गर्नु हुँदैन, सहयोग गरी आत्मीयता देखाउनु पर्छ भन्नु नै यसको ध्वन्यार्थ हो । अतः उक्त कवितामा प्रयुक्त साक्ष्यबाट अभिव्यञ्जित अर्थ ध्वनि सिद्धान्तका दृष्टिले उत्कृष्ट रहेको आकलन गर्न सकिन्छ । प्रस्तुत अध्ययन कार्यबाट ध्वन्यार्थसँग सम्बन्धित क्षेत्रमा अध्ययन गर्ने अध्येताहरूलाई अपेक्षित सहयोग मिल्ने विश्वास लिइएको छ ।
american_english: This study is based on an examination of the sound meaning contained in the poem ‘Maganeko Ghee’. The title, verses, and stanzas of the poem ‘Maganeko Ghee’ were collected as research materials in the discipline of library studies. The sound meaning contained in the title, verses, and stanzas of the poem ‘Maganeko Ghee’ was reviewed using a qualitative research framework. The oppression expressed in the poem ‘Maganeko Ghee’ is directed towards the lower classes, and its sound meaning is that people should not harm, hate, and exploit people, but should cooperate and show friendliness. Therefore, the meaning expressed through evidence in the poem ‘Maganeko Ghee’ can be considered excellent according to the sound theory. It is believed that this study will provide the expected cooperation to those who wish to study in the field of sound meaning.
british_english: This research focuses on the sound symbolism present in the poem ‘Maganeko Ghee’. The poem's title, lines, and stanzas were compiled as research material within the discipline of library studies. These components were then examined using a qualitative research framework to explore their underlying sound symbolism. The poem's expression of oppression is directed towards the underprivileged classes, conveying a message that people should refrain from harming, hating, and exploiting others, and instead promote cooperation and camaraderie. Consequently, the meaning articulated through the poem's textual evidence can be deemed excellent when evaluated through the lens of sound theory. It is hoped that this study will offer valuable assistance to those interested in conducting research within the domain of sound symbolism.
australian_english: This study centres on the phonetic symbolism embedded in the poem ‘Maganeko Ghee’. The poem's title, lines, and stanzas were gathered as research material within the field of library studies. These elements were then scrutinised through a qualitative research framework to investigate their inherent phonetic symbolism. The poem's depiction of oppression targets the lower social strata, advocating that individuals should abstain from harming, hating, and exploiting fellow human beings, and instead foster collaboration and goodwill. Therefore, the meaning conveyed through the poem's textual evidence can be regarded as exceptional when assessed within the context of phonetic theory. It is anticipated that this study will provide valuable support to those seeking to engage in research within the realm of phonetic symbolism.
informal_english: This study looks at the sound stuff in ‘Maganeko Ghee’ poem. I gathered its title, lines, and stanzas as research stuff from library studies, then reviewed them using a qualitative research approach to find the sound meaning. The poem talks about hurting lower-class people and says we shouldn’t harm, hate, or exploit anyone – we should work together and be friendly instead. The meaning in the poem checks out really well when you look at sound theory. I hope this helps anyone who wants to study sound stuff.
